name: Isezaki Ryou
source:
A man who works as a driver for the same bus company as Sora. While his looks make him seem somewhat older than he actually is, his warm demeanor makes him well-liked nonetheless. He is deceptively strong for his build, and is capable of skillfully driving a large bus as though it were a part of his own body. He and Sora are currently engaged, and are on track to be married in November.
[spoiler]Beneath his harmless front, he is actually a serial philanderer who has been secretly seeing many other women throughout his relationship with Sora. In particular, the daughter of his supervisor is currently four months pregnant with his child, and his engagement to Sora was done solely as a means of avoiding having to take responsibility for it. His proximity to Sora eventually causes him to unwittingly become Seiji's accomplice.[/spoiler]
